{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Full matrix (Tier 3): weekly schedule + manual dispatch.
# Failures here do not block merges; investigate and fix on the next cycle.

name: CI (scheduled)

on:
  schedule:
    # Mondays 03:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 3 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-scheduled
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  conda-pytest:
    name: conda pytest (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    # Agg keeps matplotlib headless; summary_plot tests also select Agg themselves.
    # Do not --ignore that file — the exclusion hid real regressions (#594 / #593).
    env:
      MPLBACKEND: Agg
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -l {0}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: linux
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            pytest-args: ""
          - os: macos-14
            runner: macos-14
            pytest-args: >-
              -m "not slowtest and not smoketest and not unimportant and not unfinished and not onlylocal and not skip_on_macos"
          - os: windows
            runner: windows-latest
            pytest-args: ""
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Cache Access Database Engine installer (Windows)
        if: matrix.os == 'windows'
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/AccessDatabaseEngine_X64.exe
          key: access-database-engine-x64-${{ hashFiles('.github/workflows/ci-scheduled.yml') }}

      - name: Install Access Database Engine (Windows)
        if: matrix.os == 'windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $installer = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/AccessDatabaseEngine_X64.exe"
          if (-not (Test-Path $installer)) {
            Write-Host "Downloading Access Database Engine 2016 x64..."
            $url = 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/3/5/C/35C84C36-661A-44E6-9324-8786B8DBE231/accessdatabaseengine_X64.exe'
            (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadFile($url, $installer)
          } else {
            Write-Host "Using cached ACE installer."
          }
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $installer -ArgumentList '/quiet','/norestart' -Wait -PassThru
          Write-Host "ACE installer exit code: $($proc.ExitCode)"
          if ($proc.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "ACE install failed" }

      - name: Setup miniconda (retry transient conda-forge errors)
        uses: Wandalen/wretry.action@v3.5.0
        with:
          action: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@v3
          with: '{"auto-update-conda":true,"miniconda-version":"latest","activate-environment":"cellpy_dev","environment-file":"github_actions_environment.yml","python-version":"3.13"}'
          attempt_limit: 3
          attempt_delay: 30000

      - name: Install mdbtools (Linux)
        if: matrix.os == 'linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y mdbtools

      - name: Install mdbtools (macOS)
        if: matrix.os == 'macos-14'
        run: brew install mdbtools

      - name: Verify Access ODBC driver (Windows)
        if: matrix.os == 'windows'
        run: |
          python -c "import pyodbc; drivers=[d for d in pyodbc.drivers() if d.startswith('Microsoft Access Driver')]; assert drivers, 'Microsoft Access ODBC driver not found'; print('Access drivers:', drivers)"

      # Windows-only (conda-forge package requires __win); kept out of the shared env file.
      - name: Install sqlalchemy-access (Windows)
        if: matrix.os == 'windows'
        run: conda install -c conda-forge sqlalchemy-access -y

      - name: Install cellpy (editable)
        run: python -m pip install -e .

      - name: pytest
        run: pytest ${{ matrix.pytest-args }}

  nbmake-linux:
    name: nbmake (linux)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -l {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup miniconda (retry transient conda-forge errors)
        uses: Wandalen/wretry.action@v3.5.0
        with:
          action: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@v3
          with: '{"auto-update-conda":true,"activate-environment":"cellpy_dev","environment-file":"github_actions_environment.yml","python-version":"3.13"}'
          attempt_limit: 3
          attempt_delay: 30000

      - name: Install mdbtools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y mdbtools

      - name: pytest with nbmake (cellpy_batch_processing)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          python -m pip install -e .
          python -m pip install kaleido==0.1.*
          python -m ipykernel install --user --name=cellpy_dev
          pytest -v --nbmake --nbmake-timeout=600 --nbmake-kernel=cellpy_dev "examples/cellpy batch utility/cellpy_batch_processing.ipynb"

  pip-install:
    name: pip install (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    # Agg keeps matplotlib headless (#594). Plotly/seaborn cases skipif when the
    # batch extra is not installed. legacy-files pulls PyTables so the suite can
    # read v4–v8 HDF5 fixtures; plotting-mpl pulls matplotlib for Agg plot tests
    # (plain `pip install -e .` / `.[legacy-files]` alone fails collection after #937).
    env:
      MPLBACKEND: Agg
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: linux
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            pytest-args: ""
          - os: macos-14
            runner: macos-14
            pytest-args: ""
          - os: windows
            runner: windows-latest
            pytest-args: tests/test_maccor.py
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Python 3.13
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Cache pip packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: matrix.os == 'linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y mdbtools

      - name: Install system dependencies (macOS)
        if: matrix.os == 'macos-14'
        run: |
          brew install mdbtools unixodbc hdf5 c-blosc

      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install pytest pytest-timeout pytest-benchmark lmfit

      # Apple Silicon needs brew HDF5/blosc paths for building/linking tables.
      - name: Install PyTables (macOS)
        if: matrix.os == 'macos-14'
        run: |
          python -m pip install cython
          export HDF5_DIR=/opt/homebrew/opt/hdf5
          export BLOSC_DIR=/opt/homebrew/opt/c-blosc
          python -m pip install tables

      - name: Install cellpy
        run: python -m pip install -e ".[legacy-files,plotting-mpl]"

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: pytest ${{ matrix.pytest-args }}

      - name: Run cellpy setup
        run: cellpy setup --silent

      - name: Run cellpy check
        run: cellpy info --check

  conda-forge:
    name: conda-forge install
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -l {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup miniconda (retry transient conda-forge errors)
        uses: Wandalen/wretry.action@v3.5.0
        with:
          action: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@v3
          with: '{"auto-update-conda":true,"activate-environment":"cellpy_dev","environment-file":"github_actions_environment.yml","python-version":"3.13"}'
          attempt_limit: 3
          attempt_delay: 30000

      - name: Install cellpy from conda-forge
        run: |
          conda create -n cellpy_conda -y
          conda activate cellpy_conda
          conda install -c conda-forge cellpy -y

      - name: Check cellpy
        run: |
          conda activate cellpy_conda
          cellpy setup -s",
  "rationale": "The pip-install job repeatedly downloads pip dependencies on every scheduled run with no dependency cache. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE supports caching dependency downloads to save CI resources. Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable (every run installs pip packages), and cache inputs exist (uv.lock and pyproject.toml for cache-key invalidation). No equivalent pip cache exists (the only existing actions/cache entry is for the Windows ACE installer). Pip cache content is immutable per version and the key invalidates on lockfile/pyproject changes, so cached content is trusted and safe. The change is additive: all existing steps, tests, matrix coverage, and required-check semantics are preserved; no permissions are weakened and no new network access, secrets, or deployment operations are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
